tagline.en_US: Save web articles and read them later through a clean interface, with the application database persisted on disk.

description.en_US: Readeck is a bookmark manager and read-later web application. It extracts and stores the readable content, text, and images from web pages for privacy and long-term archival. Users can organize items with labels, annotations, and saved search collections, perform full-text searches, and export content as EPUB e-books.
